items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He was supposed to be our best drummer we had.

ctx.x: It wouldn't be happy ghost and... Yeah, cause he, I know he's, he's still playing. Black happy, he plays in the Eureka. Yeah.
Wasn't red happy? It was a red happy.

Well, he used to play with, uh, Bob and I. Yeah, he played with Joe Oliver. I know some people say, he was an Ory, I think for a while. Yeah, he's one of the more times than me. You were supposed to be our best drummer we had, yeah. I've heard that he was very good, yeah.
